x: On the final lap, R.Langridge (S.L.H.) got away from the field to win by ten seconds; but the next nine places were sorted out only after a desperate fighting finish - 10 seconds covering all nine.
Charlie Walker made a further place on the run to Merstham, chased all the way by Roly Langridge of S.L.H. and producing a sprint finish with what he himself describes as "a desperate effort".
Gerry continued to improve and confirmed his promise in 1956 when he finished 4th in the National Junior C.C.Championship, only 27 seconds behind the winner, Roly Langridge (SLH).
